# 🛡️ Anti-Antivirus

> **"Security, but backwards."**

A humorous Windows desktop application that does the **exact opposite** of an antivirus. Built for a college "Useless Project" competition.

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

**This is a JOKE / DEMO project.** It does NOT use, create, or handle any real malware. All "threats" are harmless `.txt` files generated by the application itself. No files are ever permanently deleted — they are only moved to designated folders.

## 🎯 What Does It Do?

| Traditional Antivirus | Anti-Antivirus |
|---|---|
| Detects threats → **Removes** them | Detects threats → **Preserves** them 🏆 |
| Finds safe files → **Keeps** them | Finds safe files → **Deletes** them 🗑️ |
| High security score | Security Score: **3%** |
| Useful | Uselessness Score: **99.8%** |

## 🖥️ Features

- **Dashboard** — Professional cybersecurity dashboard with stats, scores, and a big red SCAN button
- **File Scanner** — SHA-256 hash-based scanning with animated progress bar and funny results
- **Malware Museum** — A curated collection of all preserved "threats" (harmless text files)
- **Scan History** — Complete log of every questionable security decision
- **Statistics** — Charts and scores measuring our spectacular failure

## 🚀 Installation

```bash
# 1. Clone the repository
git clone <repo-url>
cd useless_project_binary

# 2. Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 3. Run the application
python main.py
```

## 🧪 How to Test

1. Launch the application
2. Click **"Generate Demo Files"** on the Dashboard to create harmless test files
3. Click **"SCAN FILE"** and select one of the demo files from `data/demo_samples/`
4. Watch the scanning animation
5. See the hilarious results:
   - **Safe file?** → "Unfortunately, this file is too safe." → **DELETE**
   - **Demo threat?** → "Excellent! We found something dangerous." → **PRESERVE**
6. Check the **Malware Museum** to see your collection grow
7. View **Statistics** for impressively terrible security scores

## 📁 Project Structure

```
├── main.py              # Entry point
├── scanner.py           # SHA-256 hashing & demo threat detection
├── database.py          # SQLite scan history
├── file_manager.py      # Safe file operations (move, never delete)
├── demo_files.py        # Generates harmless demo test files
├── ui/
│   ├── app.py           # Main window & navigation
│   ├── dashboard.py     # Dashboard with stats
│   ├── scanner_view.py  # File scanning UI
│   ├── museum.py        # Malware Museum
│   ├── history.py       # Scan History
│   └── stats.py         # Statistics
├── data/                # Auto-created at runtime
│   ├── anti_antivirus.db
│   ├── Deleted_Safe_Files/
│   ├── Threat_Museum/
│   └── demo_samples/
└── requirements.txt
```

## 🔒 Safety Guarantees

- ✅ **No permanent deletion** — Files are only *moved* to `Deleted_Safe_Files/`
- ✅ **No file execution** — Scanned files are never executed
- ✅ **No real malware** — Detection is hash-based against our own `.txt` files
- ✅ **Confirmation dialogs** — User must confirm before any file operation
- ✅ **Clearly labeled** — The app is marked as a demo/joke project everywhere

## 🛠️ Technology

- **Python 3.10+**
- **CustomTkinter** — Modern dark-themed GUI
- **SQLite** — Scan history storage
- **hashlib** — SHA-256 file hashing
- **pathlib/shutil** — Safe file operations
